en.h.input-format: ChEMBL activity records (initial default) curate a ChEMBL export; the file may auto-select another input type. Generic activity records aggregate repeated rows by compound and can estimate evidence-unit support. Molecule table uses one row per molecule without estimating activity evidence; choose the type matching your file.
en.h.target: Selects the ChEMBL target whose records are retained; by default, a single detected target is used. Enter an ID when the file contains multiple targets; records for other targets are excluded.
en.h.activity-type: Selects the endpoint retained when the ChEMBL endpoint column is present; change it to match your experiment. IC50 (default) retains IC50 records. Ki retains Ki records. Kd retains Kd records. EC50 retains EC50 records. AC50 retains AC50 records. Potency retains records labeled Potency; endpoints are not pooled.
en.h.compound-column: Identifies the compound whose repeated generic records are aggregated; a detected ID column is selected by default, otherwise None. Select the column containing consistent compound IDs; None is unavailable for Generic activity records, and this control is disabled for a molecule table.
en.h.smiles-col: Selects the molecular structure column; the detected SMILES column is the default, otherwise the first column. Choose another column only when it contains the structures to map; these structures determine molecular representation.
en.h.value-col: Selects numeric activity values; the detected activity column is the default, otherwise None. For a molecule table, None omits numeric activity and a class column can supply labels. Generic activity records require an activity column; choose its matching unit below.
en.h.value-unit: Interprets the activity values; choose the unit used in your file unless a per-row unit column is selected. pActivity (default) uses −log10 M values directly. M converts mol/L to pActivity. mM converts millimolar concentrations. µM converts micromolar concentrations. nM converts nanomolar concentrations. pM converts picomolar concentrations; changing units changes the activity scale.
en.h.unit-column: Selects a per-row concentration-unit column; default None uses the common Unit setting. Choose a column when rows have different units; the common Unit control is then disabled, and concentrations are converted to pActivity.
en.h.document-column: Selects the document, batch or run defining an evidence unit; the detected document column is the default, otherwise None. Records within a compound and unit are summarized by their median. Choose the independent source identifier; with None, class support requires an assumed σ.
en.h.relation-column: Selects the relation column; the detected relation column is the default, otherwise None. A selected column retains only exact “=” records and excludes censored values. None applies no relation-column filter; select this column when your records contain relations.
en.h.label-col: Supplies activity-class labels for a molecule table; activity_class is selected when present, otherwise None. None retains an existing activity_class column, or derives labels from numeric activity if that column is absent. Choose a class column to use supplied labels; generic record classes are calculated from aggregated activity instead.
en.h.query-csv: Upload one CSV or TSV after building the reference map. The reference map is kept unchanged.
en.h.query-smiles-col: Required: molecular structures as SMILES. Structures are checked using the reference map policy.
en.h.query-id-col: Optional molecule ID. Without a column, IDs are N00001, N00002, etc. For measurement records, the ID groups records by compound.
en.h.representation: Morgan fingerprint (default) encodes local substructures as radius-2, 2048-bit fingerprints. Molecular descriptors uses ten standardized RDKit properties, so projection and neighbor diagnostics reflect property distances; switch to explore that representation. Structure grouping still uses Morgan fingerprints.
en.h.projection: UMAP (default) builds a nonlinear neighborhood projection. PCA gives a linear projection for a fast starting point. t-SNE gives another nonlinear neighborhood projection; switch methods to examine layout sensitivity, without treating 2D proximity as biological evidence.
en.h.occupancy: Share of grid cells that hold a molecule. Lower values leave more empty space between clusters; higher values pack molecules more tightly. It does not guarantee that neighbors stay adjacent. Default 40%.
en.h.grouping: Morgan / Butina (default) groups original Morgan fingerprints by center similarity, independently of 2D position. Supplied groups uses a molecule-table group column and its source. No grouping skips groups and cores; use it for maps above the 10,000-molecule exact-grouping limit.
en.h.group-similarity: Minimum Morgan Tanimoto similarity to a structure group center, and the threshold for similar reference molecules in neighbor evidence (also used without grouping). New molecules join an existing group at or above this value. Default 0.6.
en.h.cluster-col: Names the column containing supplied structure-group labels; default blank. Enter a complete group column when using Supplied groups with a molecule table; changing it changes group membership, not the structural representation.
en.h.cluster-source: Records the origin of supplied group labels; default blank. Enter the grouping method, parameters or provenance when using Supplied groups; this required text documents the grouping and does not compute new groups.
en.h.core-rule: Coverage uses typed Bemis–Murcko member scaffolds and scaffold-network ring fragments; the default is unchanged. Coverage with BRICS adds ring-containing BRICS fragments with dummy atoms removed and selects the largest candidate meeting the target (otherwise the highest-coverage candidate). Most frequent uses the most common typed member scaffold. FMCS searches member molecular graphs for a common substructure within its time budget. Matching respects stereochemistry. Browser core computation uses parallel workers for sufficiently large groups. FMCS always remains serial because parallel load can change timeout solutions. Previously computed rules are restored when opening a saved result.
en.h.core-coverage-target: Target fraction of group members containing the coverage or FMCS core; default 0.8. Higher targets require broader coverage and can select smaller cores; lower targets allow cores present in fewer members. Change it to adjust this coverage tradeoff; the most-frequent-scaffold rule ignores it.
en.h.fmcs-timeout: Limits each FMCS search in seconds; default 1. Increase it to allow more search time, or decrease it to stop earlier; timed-out searches return a partial core and may vary with machine speed and load. Change it only when FMCS is selected.
en.h.grid-refinement: Neighbor-refined (default) refines the initial assignment to bring representation-space neighbors closer while retaining a projection anchor. Minimum displacement keeps the initial projection-to-grid assignment (the 0.4 rule). Switch to compare layouts; neither guarantees chemical or biological similarity between adjacent cells.
en.h.activity-confidence: Estimates support for the displayed activity class from evidence units; default on. Turning it off omits this evidence calculation without changing observed activity values; use it when only observed activity is needed. Molecule tables do not estimate activity evidence.
en.h.merge-identical-documents: Merges a compound’s identical document-median activities, rounded to two decimals, into one evidence unit; default on. Turning it off counts each source document separately and can change estimated σ and support. Change it only when separately counting those documents is appropriate.
en.h.use-assumed-sigma: Uses a fixed positive between-unit standard deviation instead of estimating it; default off. Enable it when evidence-unit IDs are absent or repeats are insufficient; without IDs, each compound’s record median supplies one unit and document-offset checks do not apply. This option requires activity records and class-support estimation.
en.h.assumed-sigma: Sets the assumed between-unit standard deviation in log units; default 0.64, used only when the assumed-σ option is on. Larger values broaden activity uncertainty; smaller values narrow it, and class probabilities may change. Use a justified positive value for your measurement setting; it is not estimated from this file.
en.h.evidence-model: Gaussian (default) estimates class probabilities using the pooled between-unit variation, or the assumed σ. Exclude documents in flagged offset pairs removes evidence units containing those documents and recomputes support, falling back to Gaussian for entries with no units left. Use the second option to examine offset sensitivity; observed medians and classes stay unchanged.
en.h.support-level: A displayed class counts as supported when its estimated probability reaches this level. Higher values mark more molecules as uncertain; lower values accept weaker evidence. Default 0.8.
en.h.offset-display: Leave display unchanged (default) bases supported/uncertain status on class support and keeps an offset marker. Mark touched entries uncertain also marks every entry appearing in a flagged pair’s documents as uncertain. Use it for a stricter display of offset concerns; probabilities are unchanged.
en.h.offset-min-shared: Minimum number of shared compound entries needed to evaluate a document pair; default 3. Raising it evaluates fewer pairs with more shared evidence; lowering it includes pairs with fewer shared entries. Change it when deciding how much overlap an offset check requires.
en.h.offset-min-difference: Minimum absolute median difference between a document pair’s shared-entry values, in log units; default 1. Higher values flag only larger offsets; lower values also flag smaller offsets, provided shared-entry and sign-agreement requirements are met. Change it to match the offset size you want to flag.
en.h.offset-sign-agreement: Minimum fraction of paired differences with the same sign as the median difference; zero differences do not agree; default 0.8. Higher values require more consistent direction, while lower values accept more mixed directions. Change it to adjust directional consistency required for flagging an offset.
en.h.identity-conflicts: Stop and report (default) stops ChEMBL curation when a parent ID has conflicting standard parent identities. Exclude conflicting parents removes those parents and their records, and reports the exclusions. Choose exclusion only when omitting those entries is appropriate.
en.h.lower: Sets the upper bound of the Inactive class on the {activity} scale; values at or below it are Inactive; default 6. Raising it includes more values in Inactive; lowering it includes fewer. Change it to match your activity-class definition, keeping it below the upper threshold.
en.h.upper: Sets the lower bound of the Active class on the {activity} scale; values at or above it are Active; default 7. Raising it requires stronger activity for Active; lowering it includes more values. Change it to match your activity-class definition, keeping it above the lower threshold.
en.h.conflict-range: Flags an entry when its retained activity range exceeds this many log units; default 1. Higher values flag fewer entries and lower values flag more; records spanning both Inactive and Active thresholds are flagged regardless. Change it to adjust the range warning, not to remove records.
en.h.seed: Sets the random seed used for projection and grid refinement; default 42. A different seed can change layout positions without changing input activities. Change it to examine layout sensitivity; keep it fixed when comparing other settings.
en.h.identity: Automatic (default) uses ChEMBL parent IDs when available, with canonical-structure fallback. Require parent IDs requires a parent-ID column and uses the parent-identity path. Canonical SMILES groups by canonical representation structures; switch only when that identity definition fits your ChEMBL records.
en.h.structure-policy: Automatic (default) applies ChEMBL parent normalization unless Canonical SMILES identity is explicitly selected, which uses As recorded. ChEMBL parent normalization prepares parent structures for representation. As recorded retains the recorded structure before canonical SMILES conversion; change this ChEMBL option to match the structure definition needed.
en.h.detail: Auto (default) draws molecular structures for maps up to 2,000 molecules and a color overview for larger maps. All molecular structures requests structures at every size. Color overview shows colored cells without structures; choose it for a compact overview or full detail for structural inspection.
en.h.raster: Includes PNG and PDF exports alongside the always-exported SVG map; default on. Turn it off when SVG is sufficient to avoid those additional renderings and files. Export language remains English in either interface language.
en.h.color-mode: Observed activity (default) colors cells by their observed activity class. Activity class support shows whether evidence supports that displayed class. Neighbor reliability colors cells by representation-to-grid neighbor recall. Structure group colors by group membership; switch layers to examine these separate properties without changing positions. Neighbor evidence outlines new molecules by the evidence of their similar reference molecules; the fill still shows their own measurements. It is not a prediction.
en.h.measurement-filter: Show all molecules, reference molecules only, or new molecules only. Other molecules are faded.
en.h.group-select: Selects a structure group to highlight its members and show its core; default None. None removes group highlighting. Each group ID highlights that group and fades other cells; choose one to inspect its composition without changing map positions.
en.h.show-neighbor-links: Marks shared, grid-only and representation-only neighbors of the selected measured molecule; default on. Turn it off to hide those outlines when inspecting the map. These marks show neighborhood agreement, not confidence or predicted activity.

zh.h.input-format: ChEMBL 活性记录（初始默认）整理 ChEMBL 导出文件；载入文件时可能自动选择其他输入类型。通用活性记录按化合物聚合重复行，并可估计证据单元支持度。分子表每个分子一行，不估计活性证据；请选择与文件相符的类型。
zh.h.target: 选择保留哪个 ChEMBL 靶标的记录；默认使用自动识别出的单一靶标。文件含多个靶标时须输入 ID；其他靶标的记录会被排除。
zh.h.activity-type: 存在 ChEMBL 活性终点列时，选择保留的活性终点；应与实验相符。IC50（默认）保留 IC50 记录。Ki 保留 Ki 记录。Kd 保留 Kd 记录。EC50 保留 EC50 记录。AC50 保留 AC50 记录。效力保留标为 Potency 的记录；不同终点不合并。
zh.h.compound-column: 指定通用记录中用于聚合同一化合物重复记录的标识列；默认选择识别出的 ID 列，否则为无。请选择包含一致化合物 ID 的列；通用活性记录必须选择此列，分子表下此控件禁用。
zh.h.smiles-col: 选择分子结构列；默认使用识别出的 SMILES 列，否则使用第一列。仅在其他列包含待建图结构时更改；所选结构决定分子表征。
zh.h.value-col: 选择数值活性列；默认使用识别出的活性列，否则为无。分子表中选择无可不提供数值活性，并可用类别列提供标签。通用活性记录必须选择活性列，并在下方选择匹配的单位。
zh.h.value-unit: 指定活性数值的单位；未选逐行单位列时，应与文件单位一致。pActivity（默认）直接使用 −log10 M 数值。M 将 mol/L 浓度转为 pActivity。mM 转换毫摩尔浓度。µM 转换微摩尔浓度。nM 转换纳摩尔浓度。pM 转换皮摩尔浓度；改变单位会改变活性数值尺度。
zh.h.unit-column: 选择逐行浓度单位列；默认为无，使用统一的单位设置。各行单位不同时选择此列；此时统一单位控件禁用，浓度值会转为 pActivity。
zh.h.document-column: 选择将文献、批次或实验定义为证据单元的列；默认使用识别出的文献列，否则为无。同一化合物、同一单元内的记录取中位数。请选择独立来源的标识；选择无时，类别支持度需要假定 σ。
zh.h.relation-column: 选择关系符列；默认使用识别出的关系符列，否则为无。选择后仅保留精确的“=”记录，排除删失值。无表示不按关系符列筛选；记录含关系符时应选择该列。
zh.h.label-col: 为分子表提供活性类别标签；存在 activity_class 列时默认选择该列，否则为无。选择无时仍保留已有 activity_class 列；缺少该列时，依据数值活性计算类别。选择类别列可使用已有标签；通用记录的类别由聚合活性计算。
zh.h.query-csv: 生成参照图后上传一个 CSV 或 TSV 文件。参照图保持不变。
zh.h.query-smiles-col: 必选：包含 SMILES 结构的列，按参照图的结构处理策略检查。
zh.h.query-id-col: 可选分子 ID 列。不选时按 N00001、N00002 等编号。自己测定的数据按 ID 将多条记录归到同一化合物。
zh.h.representation: Morgan 指纹（默认）用半径为 2、长度为 2048 位的指纹编码局部子结构。分子描述符使用十项标准化 RDKit 性质，投影和近邻诊断因而反映性质距离；需要考察这种表征时可切换。结构分组仍使用 Morgan 指纹。
zh.h.projection: UMAP（默认）构建非线性邻域投影。PCA 提供线性投影，适合快速初步查看。t-SNE 提供另一种非线性邻域投影；可切换以考察布局敏感性，二维接近不应视为生物学证据。
zh.h.occupancy: 放置了分子的格子在网格中所占的比例。数值越低，簇之间留白越多；数值越高，分子排列越紧凑。该值不保证近邻在网格上相邻。默认 40%。
zh.h.grouping: Morgan / Butina（默认）按原始 Morgan 指纹与组中心的相似度分组，不依赖二维位置。提供的分组使用分子表中的分组列及其来源。不分组跳过结构组及核心骨架；分子数超过精确分组的 10,000 个上限时使用此项。
zh.h.group-similarity: 分子与结构组中心之间的最小 Morgan Tanimoto 相似度，同时也是近邻证据中相近参照分子的阈值（不分组时也使用）。新分子达到此值才归入已有结构组。默认 0.6。
zh.h.cluster-col: 指定已提供的结构组标签列；默认为空。分子表选择提供的分组时，须填写标签完整的分组列；更换该列会改变组成员，不改变分子表征。
zh.h.cluster-source: 记录已有分组标签的来源；默认为空。选择提供的分组时，须填写分组方法、参数或来源信息；该必填文字用于追溯分组，不计算新分组。
zh.h.core-rule: 覆盖率规则使用成员的带类型 Bemis–Murcko 骨架及骨架网络环片段，默认规则不变。含 BRICS 的覆盖率规则再加入移除哑原子的含环 BRICS 片段，选择达到覆盖率目标的最大候选，否则选择覆盖率最高的候选。最常见骨架规则取最常见的带类型成员骨架。FMCS 在时间预算内从成员分子图中搜索公共子结构。匹配考虑立体化学。 浏览器在组数足够多时并行计算核心。FMCS 始终串行，因为并行负载会改变超时解。打开以前的结果时会恢复已算过的规则。
zh.h.core-coverage-target: 覆盖率或 FMCS 核心需包含于组成员的目标比例；默认 0.8。调高要求覆盖更多成员，可能选出更小的核心；调低允许核心仅出现在较少成员中。需要调整覆盖率取舍时更改；最常见骨架规则不使用此参数。
zh.h.fmcs-timeout: 限制每次 FMCS 搜索的秒数；默认 1 秒。调高可延长搜索，调低会更早停止；超时搜索返回部分搜索得到的核心骨架，可能随机器速度和负载变化。仅选择 FMCS 时需要调整。
zh.h.grid-refinement: 近邻优化（默认）在保留投影位置约束的同时调整初始分配，使分子表征空间近邻在网格上更接近。最小位移保留初始的投影到网格分配（0.4 版规则）。可切换比较布局；两者均不保证相邻格子具有化学或生物学相似性。
zh.h.activity-confidence: 根据证据单元估计显示活性类别的支持度；默认开启。关闭后不进行此证据计算，实测活性值不变；仅需实测活性时可关闭。分子表不估计活性证据。
zh.h.merge-identical-documents: 将同一化合物在不同文献中的相同活性中位数（取两位小数）合并为一个证据单元；默认开启。关闭后每篇来源文献分别计数，可能改变估计 σ 和支持度。仅在适合将这些文献分开计数时更改。
zh.h.use-assumed-sigma: 使用固定的正值单元间标准差，不从数据中估计；默认关闭。缺少证据单元 ID 或重复数据不足时可开启；无 ID 时，每个化合物的记录中位数提供一个单元，不进行文献偏移检查。此项需要活性记录及类别支持度估计。
zh.h.assumed-sigma: 设置以对数单位表示的假定单元间标准差；默认 0.64，仅在启用假定 σ 时使用。调高会扩大活性不确定性，调低会缩小，类别概率可能随之变化。应依据测量情境选择有根据的正值；该数值并非从本文件估计。
zh.h.evidence-model: 高斯（默认）使用合并单元间变异或假定 σ 估计类别概率。排除被标出的偏移文献对中的文献会移除包含这些文献的证据单元，并重新计算支持度；无剩余单元的条目回退至高斯模型。可用第二项考察偏移敏感性；实测中位数及类别保持不变。
zh.h.support-level: 显示类别的估计概率达到该值时，判为“支持充分”。数值越高，被标为“不确定”的分子越多；数值越低，接受的证据越弱。默认 0.8。
zh.h.offset-display: 保持显示不变（默认）依据类别支持度确定支持充分或不确定，并保留系统偏移标记。将涉及的条目标为不确定会把被标出的文献对中任一文献涉及的所有条目显示为不确定。需要更严格地显示偏移问题时使用；概率不变。
zh.h.offset-min-shared: 评估文献对所需的最少共有化合物条目数；默认 3。调高后仅评估共有证据更多的较少文献对；调低会纳入共有条目更少的文献对。需要调整偏移检查所需重叠程度时更改。
zh.h.offset-min-difference: 文献对共有条目数值的绝对中位差下限，以对数单位表示；默认 1。调高仅标出较大的系统偏移；调低也会标出较小的偏移，同时仍须满足共有条目数及同号比例要求。需要调整所关注的偏移幅度时更改。
zh.h.offset-sign-agreement: 配对差值与中位差同号的最低比例；零差值不计为同号；默认 0.8。调高要求差值方向更一致，调低容许更多方向混合。需要调整标出系统偏移所需的方向一致性时更改。
zh.h.identity-conflicts: 停止并报告（默认）在同一母体 ID 存在冲突的标准母体身份时停止 ChEMBL 数据整理。排除冲突母体会移除这些母体及其记录，并报告排除情况。仅在适合省略这些条目时选择排除。
zh.h.lower: 设置 {activity} 尺度上非活性类别的上界；小于或等于该值判为非活性；默认 6。调高会使更多数值归为非活性，调低会减少。需要匹配活性类别定义时更改，且须低于上阈值。
zh.h.upper: 设置 {activity} 尺度上活性类别的下界；大于或等于该值判为活性；默认 7。调高要求更强的活性才归为活性，调低会纳入更多数值。需要匹配活性类别定义时更改，且须高于下阈值。
zh.h.conflict-range: 保留记录的活性跨度超过此对数单位数时，标出该条目；默认 1。调高会减少标出条目，调低会增加；记录同时跨越非活性与活性阈值时，无论跨度设置如何均会被标出。此项用于调整跨度提示，不删除记录。
zh.h.seed: 设置投影和网格优化使用的随机种子；默认 42。不同种子可能改变布局位置，不改变输入活性。考察布局敏感性时可更改；比较其他设置时应保持固定。
zh.h.identity: 自动（默认）优先使用可用的 ChEMBL 母体 ID，并可回退至规范结构。要求母体 ID 必须提供母体 ID 列，并采用母体身份路径。规范 SMILES 按规范化后的表征结构聚合；仅在该身份定义适合你的 ChEMBL 记录时切换。
zh.h.structure-policy: 自动（默认）采用 ChEMBL 母体规范化；显式选择规范 SMILES 身份时则按记录保留。ChEMBL 母体规范化为分子表征准备母体结构。按记录保留在规范 SMILES 转换前保留记录中的结构；需要匹配结构定义时更改此 ChEMBL 选项。
zh.h.detail: 自动（默认）在地图不超过 2,000 个分子时绘制分子结构，较大地图采用颜色概览。所有分子结构在任何规模下都要求绘制结构。颜色概览仅显示彩色格子，不显示结构；需要简洁概览时使用，查看结构时选择完整细节。
zh.h.raster: 除始终导出的 SVG 地图外，同时导出 PNG 和 PDF；默认开启。仅需 SVG 时可关闭，以省去这些额外渲染和文件。无论界面语言如何，导出文件均保持英文。
zh.h.color-mode: 实测活性（默认）按实测活性类别着色。活性类别支持度显示证据是否支持该显示类别。近邻可靠性按分子表征到网格的近邻召回率着色。结构组按组成员关系着色；切换图层可查看这些不同性质，不改变位置。 近邻证据用新分子的外框表示相近参照分子的证据，填充仍表示自己的测定，不是活性预测。
zh.h.measurement-filter: 显示所有分子、仅参照分子或仅新分子，其他分子淡化显示。
zh.h.group-select: 选择结构组以高亮组成员并显示其核心骨架；默认为无。无会取消组高亮。各组 ID 会高亮该组并淡化其他格子；选择后可查看组组成，不改变地图位置。
zh.h.show-neighbor-links: 标示所选已测分子的共同近邻、仅网格近邻和仅分子表征近邻；默认开启。查看地图时可关闭以隐藏这些轮廓。标记表示邻域一致性，不表示置信度或预测活性。
